# RIVAL DIALOGUE BANK

**Goes with:** `RIVAL_SYSTEM_OVERHAUL.md`.
**Answers this line in `Stuff_2.md`:** three or more rival lines for every Pokémon, for catching a Pokémon, events, event interruptions, Pseudo Stages, Gym Leaders, the Elite Four and the Champion, changing with every personality type.
*Generated by `tools/build_rival_bank.js` from `tools/rival_lines_source.js`. Edit the source, not this file.*

---

## How it works

- There are **eight personalities** (the eight character styles in your rival draft). Every line below belongs to one of them.
- **Every Pokémon.** Writing three lines by hand for each of 1673 Pokédex entries, eight times over, would be 40,152 lines that mostly say the same thing. Instead each personality has three **openers** that name the Pokémon, eighteen **type lines** and six **category lines**. The game joins an opener to the line for one of the Pokémon's types, and adds the category line. A single-type Pokémon gets 4 lines per personality; a dual-type gets 7.
- The result for every entry is stored in `data/rival_species_lines.json`. To see one: `node tools/build_rival_bank.js "Gengar"`.
- **Which line plays:** the rival says at most one Pokémon line per meeting, about the player's lead or the Pokémon that did the most last battle. A line is not repeated in the same run until the others for that Pokémon have been used.
- **Type lines talk about the type, not the exact Pokémon.** That matters most for the Strategist, whose lines count weaknesses: on a dual-type Pokémon the count is for that one type. If that bothers you in play, the Strategist's type lines are the first ones worth replacing with lines computed from the Pokémon's real matchups.
- **Slots:** `{mon}` is the species name. Where a nickname exists, a rival with Friendship 5 or more uses the nickname instead.

| Count | |
| --- | --- |
| Personalities | 8 |
| Authored lines | 528 |
| Pokédex entries covered | 1673 |
| Resolved Pokémon lines | 77,968 |
| Fewest distinct lines for any Pokémon, per personality | 4 |

### Categories

| Category | Applies to |
| --- | --- |
| First | Unevolved, can evolve |
| Middle | Middle stage |
| Final | Fully evolved |
| Single | Does not evolve |
| Form | Mega or special form |
| Titan | Base stat total 600+ |

A Mega or special form uses *Form*; otherwise a base stat total of 600 or more uses *Titan*; otherwise the evolution stage decides.

## 1. Champion-Chaser

*Cocky, quick, always measuring. Compliments come out as insults.*

### About the player's Pokémon

**Openers**

- So that's your {mon}.
- A {mon}, huh? Cute. I'll remember it when I'm Champion.
- Your {mon} keeps looking at me. It knows who's winning.

**By type**

| Type | Line |
| --- | --- |
| Normal | Normal-types. Nothing special, which is about what I expected from you. |
| Fire | Fire burns bright and burns out. I don't. |
| Water | Water goes wherever the ground lets it. I pick my own road. |
| Electric | Fast. Not faster than me, but fast. |
| Grass | Grass grows slowly. I don't have that kind of time. |
| Ice | Ice breaks if you hit it right. I always hit it right. |
| Fighting | Good. Something that can actually throw a punch. |
| Poison | Poison's for people who can't win in one hit. |
| Ground | Solid. Boring, but solid. |
| Flying | It flies. So it'll have a good view of me pulling ahead. |
| Psychic | If it reads minds, it already knows how this ends. |
| Bug | A Bug-type. You're really making this easy. |
| Rock | Hard-headed. We'd get along, if it were on the right team. |
| Ghost | Spooky. I don't scare. |
| Dragon | A Dragon? Fine. Now it's a real race. |
| Dark | Fights dirty. I respect that more than I should. |
| Steel | Tough to dent. I like a challenge. |
| Fairy | Pretty, and nastier than it looks. Like my win record. |

**By category**

| Category | Line |
| --- | --- |
| First | {mon} hasn't even evolved. Call me when it does. |
| Middle | {mon}'s halfway there. So are you. I'm not. |
| Final | A fully evolved {mon}. Finally, something worth beating. |
| Single | {mon} is what it is. No surprises. I like knowing what I'm beating. |
| Form | A special form? Showing off already. That's my job. |
| Titan | That's a serious Pokémon. Don't waste it. |

### When the player catches a Pokémon

- You caught it? I was going to. I let you have it.
- Nice throw. Mine's better, but nice.
- One more for your team. You'll need all six against me.

### Inside an event

- You stopped for this? I'd have been at the next Gym by now.
- Fine, I'll help. Faster we finish, faster I beat you.
- Don't tell anyone I stayed for this.

### Interrupting an event or the road

- Hold it. Whatever you're doing can wait. I can't.
- Bad time? Good. Let's battle.
- I've been looking for you, and I don't look for people.

### In a Pseudo Stage

- First one out picks the prize. Try to keep up.
- You're in here too? Then it's a race.
- I've already been through half of this. Want directions? No? Good.

### At a Gym Leader

- This Leader's mine first. You can have what's left.
- I already have this badge. Took me one try.
- Don't lose in there. I want you in decent shape when I beat you.

### At the Elite Four

- Four of them, then the title. I've been counting since the first route.
- If you fall here, I'm not waiting.
- The Elite Four are a formality. You're the one I think about.

### At the Champion

- That chair's mine. Try not to scuff it.
- Whoever wins in there, I'm next. Make it worth my time.
- I wanted it to be you and me at the end. Don't tell me I said that.

### Noticing the player's Legendary Blessing

- A Legendary picked you? It hasn't met me yet.
- Nice trinket. Does it win battles for you, or do you still have to do that part?
- Whatever's watching over you, tell it to watch closely. I'm about to be worth seeing.

### Seeing a Mythical Guest with the player

- What is that following you? No. Don't tell me. I'll find my own.
- It won't even look at me. Fine. I'm not looking at it either.
- You promised it something, didn't you. You'd better keep it. I hate people who don't finish things.

### At Static, a Tear, or an Ultra Beast

- The sky's cracked and you're staring at it. I'm going in. Try to keep up.
- Whatever comes out of that, I'm beating it before you do.
- That thing isn't from here. Good. I was running out of things to beat.

### Second Chance (beside the player, after the six white lines)

- Get up. You don't get to lose to anyone but me.

### First-Stage Pity

- I wasn't trying. Obviously. Take this and stop looking at me like that.
- You've had a rough start. That's all I'm saying. Here.

### After the rival wins

- See you at the League. I'll be the one on the plaque.
- That's one. I'm keeping count.
- You were closer than I'll ever admit.

### After the rival loses

- Fluke. Next time I'm not holding anything back.
- ...Fine. You're better today. Today.
- Good. I need somebody worth chasing.

### When the player catches a Pokémon

- It let itself be caught. Don't forget it had a choice.

- Places like this weren't made for us. Walk lightly.
- I'd rather go through together. Fewer things get hurt.

- A Gym tests strength. I hope it tests more than that today.

### At the Elite Four

- Four of the strongest trainers alive. Ask yourself what they protect.
- Whatever you prove in there, prove it for your Pokémon.
- I'll follow you in. I have questions for them too.

### At the Champion

- A Champion sets the example. Think about what yours will be.
- If you win, the region listens to you. Say something worth hearing.
- I believe in what you're doing. I didn't, at the start.

- Something old has taken an interest in you. Ask yourself what it wants.

- It chose you. That doesn't mean it agrees with you.

### Seeing a Mythical Guest with the player

- So the old stories are true. What did it ask of you?
- A promise to something like that should be kept even when it costs. Especially then.

### At Static, a Tear, or an Ultra Beast

### After the rival loses

- I'm not finished asking. Not yet.

## 5. Strategist

*Dry and exact. Treats every meeting as data.*

### About the player's Pokémon

**Openers**

- {mon}. Noted.
- Interesting choice, {mon}. I've already run the numbers.
- I watched your {mon} for three battles. I have questions, and answers.

**By type**

| Type | Line |
| --- | --- |
| Normal | One weakness. Efficient. Predictable. |
| Fire | Weak to three common types. I carry all three. |
| Water | Two weaknesses, broad coverage. The safe pick. You like safe. |
| Electric | One weakness. I'd lead with Ground, so I assume you've planned for that. |
| Grass | Five weaknesses. Bold. Or you haven't counted. |
| Ice | Hits what matters, resists almost nothing. A glass knife. |
| Fighting | Breaks walls. I'll simply not bring any. |
| Poison | A long game, then. I like long games. |
| Ground | Immune to Electric. That removes one of my lines. Only one. |
| Flying | Immune to Ground, weak to rocks on the field. Watch your entry. |
| Psychic | Strong until something Dark arrives. Something Dark will arrive. |
| Bug | Early power, late fall-off. So you plan to win quickly. |
| Rock | Hard to break and slow. I only need the second part. |
| Ghost | Two immunities. Annoying. I've adjusted. |
| Dragon | Resists the basics. Costs you nothing until Ice or Fairy shows up. |
| Dark | You brought that for my Psychic-type. I don't have one today. |
| Steel | Ten resistances. I'll have to be patient. I am. |
| Fairy | The answer to Dragons. Did you bring it for mine? |

**By category**

| Category | Line |
| --- | --- |
| First | {mon}, unevolved. Either you're behind schedule or it's holding something clever. |
| Middle | {mon} is one evolution short. I know the level. I'll be past it. |
| Final | {mon}, fully evolved. Now its numbers are fixed, and I know them. |
| Single | {mon} has no evolution. Nothing to wait for. I can plan around it today. |
| Form | An unusual form. Fewer records. You've made me do actual research. |
| Titan | High totals across the board. So I won't fight it. I'll fight what stands next to it. |

### When the player catches a Pokémon

- A catch at that health, with that Ball? Roughly one in three. Well done.
- That fills the gap in your team. I'll update my notes.
- You wanted that one badly. That tells me something too.

### Inside an event

- This isn't efficient. I'm staying anyway. Call it data.
- Three ways this goes. Two are bad. Do what I say and we get the third.
- You handle the talking. I'll handle whatever goes wrong.

### Interrupting an event or the road

- Now. While your team is exactly as I planned for.
- I timed this. You've used your best moves twice today already.
- Apologies for the ambush. It was the optimal moment.

### In a Pseudo Stage

- I mapped the first half. You may have a copy if you share the second.
- Split up. We cover it twice as fast and compare.
- Something in here doesn't follow the usual rules. I'd like to know why.

### At a Gym Leader

- This Leader switches on the third turn. Every time. You're welcome.
- I beat the Gym with one Pokémon to spare. I'd planned for two.
- Watch the Leader's left hand. It gives the switch away.

### At the Elite Four

- Four specialists. Four plans. I've written all of them down.
- They adjust to the challenger's team. Bring something they can't read.
- I expected to be first here. I've corrected for that.

### At the Champion

- The Champion builds against your two strongest. Plan from the third.
- I've studied every recorded title match. Nobody has done what you're about to try.
- I'd wish you luck, but you don't need luck. You need turn four to go right.

### Noticing the player's Legendary Blessing

- That object wasn't in your bag last time. I've noted what changed in your battles since.
- A blessing. So that's the variable I couldn't account for.
- Once per stage, I think. I've been counting when you use it.

### Seeing a Mythical Guest with the player

- That species isn't in any record I trust. I'm revising several assumptions.
- It follows but doesn't battle. So the benefit is elsewhere. Interesting.
- You're avoiding something on purpose lately. A condition, then. I'll work out which.

### At Static, a Tear, or an Ultra Beast

- The usual numbers stop working near that crack. I've had to start a new notebook.
- Both sides are affected equally. Then it's a question of who adapts first. Me.
- It appeared after you'd repeated one habit for six stages. That's a cause, not a coincidence.

### Second Chance (beside the player, after the six white lines)

- I ran this one too. It only works with both of us. On your feet.

### First-Stage Pity

- I adjusted my team downward. Don't take it personally. A rival who never leaves the first stage is no use to my plans.
- Five early losses is a pattern, and patterns can be fixed. Here. Start with this.

### After the rival wins

- As planned. Mostly. Turn six surprised me.
- You lost on the switch. Think about it.
- I'll need a new plan next time. You'll have learned.

### After the rival loses

- Unexpected. Good. I learn nothing from winning.
- Where did I go wrong? No, don't tell me. I'll find it.
- I'll have an answer for that by the next town.

| Form | People will want that one. Watch your back. |
| Titan | That much strength needs a calm trainer. |

### When the player catches a Pokémon

- It's safe now.
- Good. Something was hunting it.
- Look after it.

### Inside an event

- I'll stay.
- Get the small ones out first.
- Behind me.

### Interrupting an event or the road

- Stop. ...I need to know you can handle what's ahead.
- Battle me. Then I'll let you pass.
- It isn't safe further on. Show me you're ready.

### In a Pseudo Stage

- I'll take the front.
- Something's wrong with this place. Stay together.
- I cleared the first rooms. Go carefully past them.

### At a Gym Leader

- You're ready.
- The Leader's tough. Fair, though.
- I'll wait outside.

### At the Elite Four

- This is as far as I can walk with you.
- Your team's tired. Rest first. Then go.
- Come back out.

### At the Champion

- You don't need me in there.
- ...I'm proud of you. That's all.
- Whatever happens. I'll be here.

### Noticing the player's Legendary Blessing

- Something walks with you. ...Good.
- Keep that safe. People will want it.
- It watches you. So do I.

### Seeing a Mythical Guest with the player

- ...I see it too. I won't tell anyone.
- It's small. Keep it out of the rain.
- You gave your word. Keep it.

### At Static, a Tear, or an Ultra Beast

- Stay back from it.
- It's frightened. Frightened things hurt people.
- If it comes out, get behind me.

### Second Chance (beside the player, after the six white lines)

- I'm here. Stand up. I'll hold them.

### First-Stage Pity

- I held back. You'd do the same for me.
- Here. Take it. ...Get through the first stretch.

### After the rival wins

- You're hurt. Let me see your team.
- ...You'll get there.
- Not yet. Soon.

### After the rival loses

- Good.
- You're stronger than I thought. I'm glad.
- Then I don't need to worry about you.

---

## 7. Prodigy

*Precise and condescending. Terrified of being ordinary.*

### About the player's Pokémon

**Openers**

- A {mon}. I see.
- Your {mon}'s form is off. Slightly. I'd fix that.
- I raised a {mon} once. Correctly.

**By type**

| Type | Line |
| --- | --- |
| Normal | A Normal-type. Unremarkable, though I suppose that suits your style. |
| Fire | Fire-types reward precision. Most people only bring enthusiasm. |
| Water | Reliable. Everyone's first idea. |
| Electric | Speed is nothing without accuracy. I assume you've trained both? |
| Grass | Grass-types need careful handling. I can already see where you skimped. |
| Ice | Elegant. Fragile. It takes real skill to use well. |
| Fighting | Brute force. It works until it meets technique. |
| Poison | A slow method for people who can't finish cleanly. |
| Ground | Dependable. Not what I'd call refined. |
| Flying | Its wing position is lazy. You've let it get away with that. |
| Psychic | At last, a type that thinks. Shame about the trainer. |
| Bug | I had one of those when I was five. |
| Rock | Sturdy and crude. A beginner's idea of defence. |
| Ghost | Tricky. Tricks are for those who can't win outright. |
| Dragon | A Dragon in untrained hands. What a waste. |
| Dark | Underhanded. I don't need to be. |
| Steel | Acceptable. Properly raised, it would be excellent. |
| Fairy | People underrate them. I never have. I underrate nothing. |

**By category**

| Category | Line |
| --- | --- |
| First | {mon} is still unevolved? Mine evolved weeks ago. |
| Middle | {mon} is at the awkward stage. Most trainers ruin them here. |
| Final | A final-stage {mon}. Adequate. The moveset is where you'll have gone wrong. |
| Single | {mon} doesn't evolve, so there's no excuse for it being under-trained. |
| Form | A rare form. In the right hands it would be a masterpiece. |
| Titan | That Pokémon is better than you are. I say it as a fact, not an insult. |

### When the player catches a Pokémon

- You used two Balls more than necessary.
- A passable catch. Its nature's wrong for your team, but passable.
- I'd have weakened it properly first. Still. It's yours.

### Inside an event

- This is beneath me. ...Move over, you're doing it wrong.
- I'll handle it. Watch, and try to learn something.
- People are looking. Fine. Let's do it perfectly.

### Interrupting an event or the road

- You. I've been made to wait. I don't wait.
- A battle. Now. I need to correct something from last time.
- I had a flawless record before I met you. We're fixing that.

### In a Pseudo Stage

- I solved this place in half the expected time. Naturally.
- Try not to touch anything. I've set it up exactly right.
- You may follow me. Quietly.

### At a Gym Leader

- The Leader called my battle 'textbook'. They meant it as praise.
- I didn't lose a single Pokémon in there. Did you?
- Do try to win properly. Sloppy badges embarrass everyone.

### At the Elite Four

- The Elite Four expected me sooner. I'll apologise by winning.
- My family has had someone in that Hall for three generations. No pressure, they said.
- If you get through first, I'll never hear the end of it. So don't.

### At the Champion

- That title was supposed to be mine by now. Everyone says so. Everyone.
- If it has to be someone else, I suppose... no. Go. Before I change my mind.
- Don't make a single mistake in there. I'd notice.

### Noticing the player's Legendary Blessing

- A Legendary's favour. My family has had three. None of them needed it.
- It gave you that? Standards are slipping.
- Don't lean on it. Borrowed strength shows.

### Seeing a Mythical Guest with the player

- A Mythical. Travelling with you. I've read every book there is, and it chose... I see.
- I assume there are terms. There are always terms. Do try to read them.
- It's looking at me as if I'm the strange one.

### At Static, a Tear, or an Ultra Beast

- That creature breaks four rules I was taught were absolute. I find that personally offensive.
- A Beast Ball. Crude. I suppose it's all they had time to design.
- If anyone is going to be first through that Tear, it's going to be someone qualified.

### Second Chance (beside the player, after the six white lines)

- Unacceptable. You lose when I say you lose. Get up, and do it properly this time.

### First-Stage Pity

- Your lead is wrong, your coverage is wrong, and you've been over-levelling one Pokémon. I held back so you'd last long enough to fix it.
- Take this. It's the correct item for your team. You'd have found it eventually. Probably.

### After the rival wins

- As expected.
- You made four errors. I'll write them down for you.
- Better than last time. Still not good.

### After the rival loses

- That... wasn't in the plan.
- Don't tell anyone. No. Tell them. I'll win it back in front of everybody.
- I made one mistake. One. It won't happen twice.

---

## 8. Underdog

*Nervous, earnest, stubborn. Counts every small win.*

### About the player's Pokémon

**Openers**

- Wow. Is that your {mon}?
- Your {mon} looks so strong. Mine are getting there.
- I've been reading about {mon}. Yours is nothing like the pictures. It's better.

**By type**

| Type | Line |
| --- | --- |
| Normal | Normal-types don't get much credit. I know how that goes. |
| Fire | I wanted a Fire-type so badly when I started. |
| Water | Mine's scared of deep water. We're working on it. |
| Electric | It's so fast. I can barely follow it. |
| Grass | It grew a lot, didn't it? You can tell somebody cared. |
| Ice | I'd be nervous to train one. They seem so particular. |
| Fighting | It never gives up, does it? I like that. I'm trying to be like that. |
| Poison | Everyone avoids them. I bet it's glad it found you. |
| Ground | Slow and steady. That's sort of my whole plan. |
| Flying | I always watch them and think, imagine just going. |
| Psychic | Does it know I'm nervous? It knows. Hi. |
| Bug | Bug-types start small and surprise everyone. That's the dream, right? |
| Rock | It took a lot of hits to get that tough. I get it. |
| Ghost | It's a bit scary. I'm not going to say that to its face. |
| Dragon | A Dragon... I'm years away from one of those. |
| Dark | People judge them too fast. People do that. |
| Steel | I wish I had armour like that some days. |
| Fairy | Tiny and tougher than everybody thinks. My favourite kind. |

**By category**

| Category | Line |
| --- | --- |
| First | {mon} hasn't evolved yet? Mine neither! We're on the same page, sort of. |
| Middle | {mon} already evolved once. I cried when mine did. Don't tell anyone. |
| Final | A fully evolved {mon}. I'm not there yet. I will be. |
| Single | {mon} is just itself, start to finish. I like that. |
| Form | I've only seen that form in books. Can I look? I won't touch. |
| Titan | I'm not ready to fight that. Give me a month. Okay, two. |

### When the player catches a Pokémon

- First throw? It takes me about nine.
- It likes you already. How do you do that?
- I was too scared to try for that one. Good for you. Really.

### Inside an event

- I'm not sure I'll be much help. I'm staying, though.
- Tell me what to do. I can do it. I think I can do it.
- I messed this up last time. Not today.

### Interrupting an event or the road

- S-sorry! I know it's a bad time. I have to try now or I'll lose my nerve.
- Please battle me. I've been practising one thing for a week.
- I followed you for two routes working up to this. That sounds bad. Battle?

### In a Pseudo Stage

- I only got this far because I refused to turn back. Is that a strategy?
- Can we go together? Not because I'm scared. A little because I'm scared.
- I found a shortcut by falling down it. It still counts.

### At a Gym Leader

- I lost here twice. Third time's tomorrow.
- You'll win first try. You always do. I'll get there.
- The Leader remembered my name! It's because I keep coming back.

### At the Elite Four

- I can't believe I'm standing at this door.
- Whatever happens to me in there, I got here. Nobody thought I would.
- You go first. I want to watch how it's done. Then I'm going to do it.

### At the Champion

- When we started I couldn't beat a single route trainer. Look where we are.
- Win it. Then wait there. I'm coming for you, however long it takes.
- I used to want to be you. Now I just want to beat you. That's better, right?

### Noticing the player's Legendary Blessing

- A Legendary noticed you? Nothing's ever noticed me. That's okay. It's okay.
- Can I see it? ...It's warm. Wow.
- If something like that believed in me, I think I'd cry. I'd definitely cry.

### Seeing a Mythical Guest with the player

- Is that... no. No way. Those are just stories. Hi. Oh my gosh. Hi.
- It let me stand this close. That's the best thing that's happened to me all year.
- Whatever you promised, keep it, okay? For those of us who'll never get asked.

### At Static, a Tear, or an Ultra Beast

- I don't know what that is and my legs have stopped working.
- It's not from here either, huh. I sort of know how that feels.
- If you're going in, I'm going in. Somebody has to carry the bags.

### Second Chance (beside the player, after the six white lines)

- You never once let me quit. So you don't get to either. Come on. Together.

### First-Stage Pity

- I know what losing at the start feels like. Five times? I did eleven. Here. This helped me.
- I didn't go all out. Please don't be upset. Somebody did the same for me once.

### After the rival wins

- I won? I won. I won!
- I want you to know I worked so hard for that.
- Don't go easy next time. Promise me.

### After the rival loses

- Okay. Okay. I know what to fix.
- Closer than last time. It was, wasn't it?
- One day. I mean it.

## Adding to the bank

- A fourth opener for a personality adds one line to every Pokémon at once.
- A hand-written line for one species goes in an `override` map keyed by species id and is used first. Good candidates: the starters, each rival's own ace, and Pokémon tied to an event (the Poli-Pond Poliwag, the Flight North Bug-type).
- Every new line should pass three tests: it could only be said by that personality; it is under 25 words; it does not need the line before it.
